result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, with the oldest first within each priority. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions stay out as before.

I changed one query, `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `DataStore.java`. It now uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …, t.opened_date, t.id` as the sales-rep list, and I updated its doc comment to match. `RegionManagerService` is the only caller, so nothing else changes order.

I ran `Region*` and `DemoScenarioTest` and they passed. I didn't add a test for your T-1 to T-5 example, so the new order isn't directly tested.
